title: useRadioState Hook
description:
Implement a `useRadioState` hook that manages a single selected option and returns `{ value, select, options }`. Only one option can be selected at a time. `value` is always one of the provided options.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { value, select, options } = useRadioState(['xs', 'sm', 'md', 'lg'], 'md');
```
ai_context: Common mistake: trying to validate that the selected option exists in the options array inside select() — while good practice, beginners often add this check incorrectly with indexOf instead of includes, or forget to handle the case at all.
